privacy.intro: This page explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we keep your data protected.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.description: We collect account details, profile information, and usage analytics needed to provide learning features and improve platform quality.

use.title: How we use data
use.description: Your data is used to authenticate access, personalize your experience, process subscriptions, and support course progress tracking.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: We keep data only as long as it is required for service delivery, legal obligations, and security operations.

choices.title: Your choices

deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to request deletion of your Darnozom LMS (lms-mobile) account and the personal data associated with it. You do not need to have the app installed to submit a request.

howTo.title: How to request account deletion
howTo.description: Send an email to {email} with the subject "Account Deletion Request". Include the email address and username registered on your Darnozom LMS account. You can also submit the same request through our Contact page. We may ask you to verify ownership of the account before processing.

deleted.title: Data that will be deleted
deleted.description: When your request is approved, we permanently delete your account profile (name, email, username, phone, avatar), authentication credentials, course enrollments and progress, chat messages tied to your account, notifications, and other personal content associated with your user ID, except where retention is required as described below.

retained.title: Data that may be retained
retained.description: We may retain limited records when required by law or for legitimate business purposes, such as billing and payment records, fraud-prevention logs, and anonymized analytics that no longer identify you. Retained records are kept only for the period required (typically up to 7 years for financial records) and are not used for marketing.

timeline.title: Processing time
timeline.description: We aim to process account deletion requests within 30 days of verifying your identity. You will receive a confirmation email when the deletion is complete. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

inApp.title: In-app deletion
inApp.description: If you still have access to the Darnozom LMS mobile or web app, you may also contact support from within the app using the same email address above. The web request on this page remains available if you have uninstalled the app.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms describe platform usage requirements, subscription rules, and acceptable behavior for all users.

account.title: Account responsibility
account.description: You are responsible for maintaining account security and ensuring the accuracy of information used on the platform.

billing.title: Subscription and billing
billing.description: Paid plans are billed according to the selected cycle, and plan changes may affect billing dates and access limits.

content.title: Content usage
content.description: Course content is licensed for authorized learning use and cannot be redistributed without explicit permission.

updates.title: Policy updates
updates.description: We may update these terms over time, and continued use of the platform indicates acceptance of updated terms.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.description: You may only publish content you own or are licensed to share. You may not post illegal, harmful, hateful, or misleading material, infringe anyone’s intellectual property, plagiarize or resell others’ work, impersonate other people or organizations, or attempt fraud. Violating these rules may result in content removal, suspension, or permanent account termination.

returnPolicy.title: Return & Refund Policy
returnPolicy.intro: All purchases, course enrollments, and digital subscriptions on Darnozom LMS are final and non-refundable. Please review this policy carefully before completing your purchase.

noRefunds.title: Strict No-Return & No-Refund Policy
noRefunds.description: Due to the digital nature of our educational content, users cannot return courses or request refunds once a purchase is completed. All sales are final, and we do not issue refunds, returns, or exchanges for change of mind, personal scheduling conflicts, or lack of time.

immediateAccess.title: Immediate Digital Access
immediateAccess.description: Upon successful payment, immediate and unrestricted access to course materials, videos, downloadable documents, and quizzes is provisioned. Because digital learning assets cannot be physically returned once accessed, all payments are non-refundable.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions & Auto-Renewal
subscriptions.description: Subscription payments are non-refundable. You may cancel your subscription auto-renewal at any time to avoid future billing cycles, and you will retain full access to all subscription benefits until the end of your current paid period.

technicalIssues.title: Technical Support & Troubleshooting
technicalIssues.description: If you experience any technical difficulties accessing your purchased courses or digital content, our technical support team is ready to assist. Technical difficulties do not constitute grounds for a refund, and we will work with you to ensure your access is restored.

contact.title: Questions Prior to Purchase
contact.description: If you have any questions or require clarification about course content or prerequisites before purchasing, please reach out to our team via WhatsApp or email prior to completing your transaction.

messages.author: Student
messages.text: I didn't understand step 3 in Lesson 4 — can you explain it another way?

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Of course. Your instructor solves it in two stages. Here is the same idea in simpler words, plus one extra example from the unit.

messages.author: Student
messages.text: Could you give me one practice problem like that?

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Try this: if x + 4 = 11, what is x? Walk through both stages the same way Lesson 4 does.

messages.author: Instructor
messages.text: Build me a 10-question quiz from Unit 2, mixed difficulty.

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Done — 10 questions drawn from Unit 2, auto-graded, ready to publish to your class.

messages.author: Instructor
messages.text: Add two short-answer items and keep the rest multiple choice.

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Updated. Eight MCQs plus two short answers with model answers attached for grading.

messages.author: Instructor
messages.text: Summarize the uploaded syllabus and list what students should finish before the midterm.

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: From syllabus.pdf: Units 1–3 are required before midterm, with Lab 2 and Quiz 1 marked as prerequisites.

messages.author: Instructor
messages.text: Turn that into a short checklist I can post in the course.

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Ready — a 5-item checklist matching your syllabus wording, formatted for the announcements board.

messages.author: Student
messages.text: I'm stuck on the practice set — which lesson should I rewatch first?

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Start with Unit 3 · Lesson 1 (minutes 4–9). The practice set uses the same worked example.

messages.author: Student
messages.text: After that, can you quiz me on just those ideas?

messages.author: Assistant
messages.text: Yes — three quick checks from practice-set.pdf, no new topics. Ready when you are.
